items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: But I did the first Johnny Mathis dates, the first Mahalia Jackson dates, the first Aretha Franklin dates, Barbra Streistan‟s Funny Girl. The Record Of The Year, what‟s the name…
No, not Natalie Cole. What‟s the great white singer, a woman singer, her daughter‟s a singer now. Liza Minellia.
